title: llmsa: Measurement System Analysis for Pipelines Built on Large Language Models
description: Treats a pipeline built on a large language model as a measurement system and validates it with crossed precision studies (variance components, gauge repeatability and reproducibility), attribute agreement (Krippendorff's alpha, Cohen's kappa), bias and linearity, Plackett-Burman robustness screening with Lenth's method, simulation-based study planning, Westgard-rule control charts and a reproducible validation report. R package.
